test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the sentence that has a spelling error.**

A - One has to understand the rudimentery fact that intelligence and intellect are at two opposite poles.

B - An intellectual person may have all the knowledge of the world but won’t know how to give it a shape.

C - Knowledge will plague the individual if he does not have the intelligence to express it.

D - Without basic intelligence, an individual is trapped within himself manifesting conflicts and ignorance in the external world.

options.text: Without basic intelligence, an individual is trapped within himself, manifesting conflicts and ignorance in the external world.
An intellectual person may have all the knowledge of the world but won’t know how to give it a shape.
Knowledge will plague the individual if he does not have the intelligence to express it.
One has to understand the rudimentery fact that intelligence and intellect are at two opposite poles.

solution:
The correct answer is **'One has to understand the rudimentery fact that intelligence and intellect are at two opposite poles.'**
